profile.tagline: I build fast, friendly web products — from pixel-perfect React interfaces to scalable Python backends.
summary: I'm a full-stack developer with 3+ years of experience across the complete software development life cycle.

On the frontend I work with React, Next.js and React Native; on the backend with Python, Django, FastAPI, Celery, Redis and PostgreSQL — building scalable APIs, designing databases and optimizing systems.
I'm a little obsessed with performance: I cut main-page load time in an enterprise HRMS from 30s to 4s and lifted Lighthouse scores from 60–75 to 90+.
profile.facts: Kateryna Stetsenko is a full-stack developer (3+ years) specializing in React/Next.js frontends and Python/Django backends, with a focus on performance optimization, API and database design, and real-time features. Master's degree in Computerized and Robotic Systems (KhNURE, 2025).
profile.availability: Open to new projects (full-time, contract, freelance; remote).

projects.title: Projects with numbers, not just buzzwords.

horilla.name: Horilla
horilla.description: Open-source international HRMS and ERP platform for enterprise operations.
highlights: Cut load time by up to 85% on main pages and 50% on secondary views by splitting monolithic queries into async HTMX requests and client-side filtering.
Designed Django polymorphic models for a non-duplicating DB architecture across complex HRMS entities, simplifying migrations.
Built dynamic UI components with Alpine.js/HTMX and grew test coverage with automated unit tests.

ctrl-ai.name: Ctrl.ai
ctrl-ai.description: Fleet and driver management platform with real-time operational tracking.
highlights: Built Celery/Redis task queues for heavy asynchronous background processing and scheduling workflows.
Implemented real-time data fetching and state management with GraphQL and Redux Toolkit, reducing API payload sizes.
Optimized PostgreSQL models, wrote schema migrations and automated deployment scripts.

pikt.name: Pikt
pikt.description: AI-driven website creation platform with integrated e-commerce: users launch professional sites with intelligent design generation and payments.
highlights: Engineered server-rendered and statically generated pages with Next.js, drastically improving initial load time and SEO discoverability.
Monitored and improved Web Vitals with Lighthouse: code splitting, image optimization and bundle-size audits.
Developed the component architecture for intelligent layout generation, linking user input directly to automated e-commerce payment flows.

logo-contests.name: Design contest platform
logo-contests.description: Platform where customers launch logo design contests and receive 200+ designs from many designers, working directly with clients.
highlights: Implemented bidirectional real-time communication for live design contests and chat with WebSockets.
Secured authentication and access control across web and desktop (Electron) apps with Auth0.
Integrated Stripe for multi-party marketplace payments: refunds, payouts and automated invoicing.
Lifted Lighthouse from 60–75 to 90+ by replacing React hooks overhead with lightweight vanilla JS and optimizing Next.js static output.
